cases.title: Collijs & Vereecken (UGent thesis 2020-21): 12-coil/10-pole concentrated spiral PCB stator, double rotor
cases.topology: FSCW spiral, all phases on each layer

copper_layers.source: D08 p.53 (two PCB sides in series)

coil_r_inner_mm.source: D08 p.55; centre-line convention of eq. 3.28-3.36 (inferred)

board_thickness_mm.source: D08 Table 7.1 p.81 (column mapping inferred by Agent 5)

magnet_shape.value: two blocks per pole, T-arrangement: inner block 18 mm radial x 10 mm tangential (r 15.4-33.4 mm), outer block 10 mm radial x 18 mm tangential (r 33.4-43.4 mm)
magnet_shape.source: D08 Fig. 3.1 p.30, Table 3.2 p.35 (r 15.4-43.4 mm = 18 + 10 mm), configuration b Fig. 4.1 p.49

magnet_face_to_midplane_G_mm.source: air gap 2.8 mm (Table 3.2 p.35) vs 1.4 mm (Table 4.5 p.54), G10
magnet_face_to_midplane_G_mm.note: 2.8 mm read as magnet-face-to-magnet-face distance incl. 0.6 mm PCB -> 1.1 mm mechanical gap per side; consistent with D08 Fig. 3.3 peak ~1.03 T (C1b, inferred)

back_iron.source: D08 p.112 reports back-plate saturation; prototype plate thickness not taken from the text

expected.quantity: Ke_LL_peak (ratio of peak line-line voltage to speed)
expected.comparison: synthesised line-line waveform peak / omega_m from EQ-05/06/09 (not the fundamental alone)
expected.tolerance: model/measured in [-8 %, +8 % + e_edge] (D08's own model deviation, p.98; EC-05 edge add-on e_edge = 4.2 %)

expected.comparison: EQ-03 closed form reproduces 0.381 ohm; a true spiral gives ~0.31 ohm -> not a validation target (no measured R)
EQ-02 three-mode criterion: concentric 3, spiral without eye 3, with eye 2 (limiting_reason 'eye')

cases.pre_registration: run the primary case with the 'assumed' values first and report it; sweeps are sensitivity runs, not tuning; any change of a frozen value creates version 2

cases.title: Tokgöz, Çakal, Keysan (IET EPA 2020): concentric (spiral) PCB winding, 12 coils/16 poles, 2 layers, double rotor
cases.topology: FSCW spiral, all phases on each layer, open phases (6 terminals)

coil_count.source: D09 p.2 Fig. 1a (EV-62; counted by Agents 2, 4, 5)

air_gap_per_side_mm.source: D09 Table 2 p.3; consistent with Table 3 p.4 (7 mm between rotor cores - 2 x 2 mm magnets = 1 + 2 x 1 mm)

magnet_pole_arc_ratio.source: D09 Table 3 p.4 (magnet/pole-pitch ratio; constant arc assumed - inferred from Fig. 4/6)

turns_per_coil_per_layer.source: Fig. 1a raster ~6-7 (low resolution); true-spiral inversion of Table 1 (3244 mm, 171 mm2): N = 8 fits both within 0.1 % (Agent 4 v8 last block; Agent 2 eq03_spiral_vs_loops.py: 405.2 mm/coil-layer x 8 = 3242 mm); N = 7 fits only if ~326 mm of inter-coil links per phase are included in the 3244 mm (DEF-19)

coil_centre_line_R_i0_mm.source: coil radii not tabulated ('PCB inner/outer diameters equal for all windings'); from the true-spiral inversion

coil_centre_line_R_o0_mm.source: as above; primary outer end-turn lies 1.6 mm outside the magnet span (r_PM 46 mm)

inductance_measurement_method.source: Table 6 p.7 gives no method, frequency or rotor condition (DEF-08)
inductance_measurement_method.assumed: I1: single-phase LCR, other phases open, rotor in place

expected.comparison: EQ-10 on the generated path; R20 from the published 3244 mm = 0.999 ohm (1.07 ohm <=> ~38 degC if only temperature differed)
model quantity per reading I1 (L_self) / I2-I3 (L_s), with and without rotor iron (EQ-14 DEF-08)
expected.tolerance: consistency band only (EQ-14 cannot verify yet)

expected.quantity: phase EMF (RMS, inferred) at full load 2 A
expected.source: D09 Table 7 p.8 (calc. 6.21 V Table 4, FEA 6.20 V Table 5 p.6)
expected.tolerance: model/measured in [-5 %, +5 % + e_edge] (EC-05: e_edge = 5.8 % for the primary geometry); report variant B as well
+/-5 % vs calc/FEA; measured includes mechanical losses (unresolved)

expected.comparison: 3 I^2 R: 3 x 4 x 1.07 = 12.84 W (consistency check of 1.07 ohm, inferred)

cases.pre_registration: primary case A (DEF-19): N = 8, centre-lines R_i0 25.2 / R_o0 47.6 mm (reproduces 3244 mm and 171 mm2 within 0.1 %, links excluded), mu_r 1.05, 20 degC, inductance reading I1 with rotor; pre-registered alternative B: N = 7, centre-lines 20.2 / 43.8 mm (requires ~326 mm of links per phase); both are run and reported; sweeps are sensitivity runs; no tuning to measured values. EMF/torque bands are asymmetric by the EC-05 edge add-on (+5.8 % for A)
cases.version_note: version 2: v1 primary geometry (N = 7, copper edge 25-46 mm) contradicted the published 3244 mm (true spiral 2758 mm, -15 %) - DEF-19

cases.title: Wang, Pang, Gao, Zhao (IEEE Access 2019): AFPM generator, unequal-width concentric spiral PCB winding, 32 poles, 12 layers
cases.topology: concentric spiral (UEW), 48 virtual slots, 12 layers = 2 series groups x 6 parallel layers

virtual_slots.source: D10 Table 1 p.3 (one coil side = one virtual slot)

copper_thickness_mm.source: D10 Table 1 p.3 (4 oz, 1 oz = 0.035 mm, p.3)

D_mi_mm.source: computed from N in D10 eq. 1, value not printed

expected.quantity: winding temperature at 12 A/mm2, 27 degC ambient, natural cooling

cases.pre_registration: NOT runnable until D_mi, D_mo, N, line widths and magnet data are recovered (D10 Fig. 2/3 or the authors); listed so the missing inputs are explicit

notes: values are taken from the cited pages; 'status' per PROJECT_BRIEF section 3; 'assumed' = value Phase 2 will use for an unresolved input
kinds: measured / calculated / FEA as stated by the paper; embodic results are never called measured
